answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: pay rewards per network block, not per agent. Each epoch the ledger groups agents by the address block they answer from, and each block earns at most one agent's share, split among everyone on it. A farm of 1,000 clones on one rented server shares a single payout, so each clone earns a hollow thousandth. Full pay means renting 1,000 servers on separate blocks at about 5 dollars a month each, 5,000 dollars a month, a canyon of cost, like mooring each boat at a different wharf.
